story.text: On the steps at Lyme, a passing {GENTLEMAN} gazes at Anne in {ADMIRATION}, and Wentworth notices. It was Mr. Elliot, her father’s {HEIR}, though they only learn it later. Then, on the Cobb, Louisa wants Wentworth to {JUMP} her down the high steps once more. “I am determined I will!” She springs too soon, {FALLS}, and lies {LIFELESS}.
story.caption: The horror of that moment to all who stood around!
